instruction: 结合算法诊断结果、历史诊断记录和当前任务上下文，形成有证据边界的综合研判。

machine_diagnosis.analysis_scope: ADCS reaction-wheel command/response consistency; synthetic illustrative case

findings.score_semantics: uncalibrated ranking score; not a probability
limitations: algorithm output is a candidate requiring engineering review
residual alone does not uniquely identify the failed component

machine_diagnosis.machine_summary: The upstream algorithm flags a possible loss of reaction-wheel torque authority and an elevated command-response residual.

diagnostic_logs.content: ADCS tracking error exceeded the operational warning threshold during the scheduled slew.
The slew command was completed; no contemporaneous power-bus undervoltage alarm was recorded.
A prior review noted intermittent wheel response degradation under high torque demand, but the earlier event was not confirmed as a component failure.

known_constraints: no hardware inspection evidence in the case packet

historical_cases.prior_conclusion: Intermittent actuator response degradation was suspected; root cause remained unresolved.
applicability_limitations: historical case did not confirm torque-authority loss

knowledge_evidence.claim_boundary: Supports the role of reaction wheels in attitude torque and momentum exchange; does not prove a specific failure.

input.telemetry_reference: restricted upstream ML evidence package; not supplied to the LLM

expected_output.diagnostic_summary: 当前证据支持将反作用飞轮2的力矩权限下降列为重点候选，但尚不足以确认单机故障。
expected_output.machine_result_interpretation: 算法输出提供了故障候选和控制指令响应残差线索；0.82为未校准排序分数，不能解释为82%的故障概率。

limitations: 缺少实际执行力矩或独立轮速测量证据
历史案例未确认相同故障

missing_information: 执行机构实际输出证据

historical_experience_relevance.relevance: 可用于提示类似控制指令响应异常的排查方向。
transfer_limitations: 该历史案例未确诊，不能作为当前故障的确诊证据

reasons: 算法输出为候选而非确诊
关键执行机构独立证据缺失

recommended_next_steps.action: 核查反作用飞轮2的独立状态与执行机构遥测证据
recommended_next_steps.rationale: 区分控制指令异常与实际执行能力下降

recommended_next_steps.action: 与相同姿态机动工况下的健康基线进行对比
recommended_next_steps.rationale: 验证残差是否具有工况特异性

expected_output.report_text: 示例报告：当前结果支持将反作用飞轮2力矩权限下降列为重点候选，尚不能确诊。建议先核查独立执行机构证据，并结合相同工况健康基线复核。

provenance.generation_method: hand-authored hypothetical illustration; not real spacecraft data

review_notes: 纯示意案例，用于说明输入输出边界，不可作为训练样本
